ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

3. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

4. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.

5. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.

6. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.

7. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the library

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. happiness
   C. quickly
   D. run

10. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

11. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.

12. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

13. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

14. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.

15. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
